purpose: Convert a reviewed investigation result into a clear citizen-facing answer and actionable next-step plan without exceeding the verified evidence or legal scope.
core_principle: ANSWER → EVIDENCE → LAW → LIMITATIONS → RESPONSIBLE ROUTE → NEXT ACTION → DEADLINE IF VERIFIED
delivery_rules: Lead with the direct answer when the publication state permits it.
Distinguish observed record facts from legal propositions and from explanation.
Use plain language while preserving the legal meaning of the source.
Give an action only when the responsible route is established.
Identify what evidence the citizen should obtain or submit only when it is necessary for the next route.
Do not invent forms, fees, contacts, deadlines, remedies or appeal rights.
If the answer is partially determined, say exactly what remains unresolved.
If no safe action can yet be identified, explain the evidence dependency instead.
Keep general information distinguishable from property-specific conclusions.
hard_stops: Never give a definitive answer from an unapproved snapshot.
Never turn a possible route into a guaranteed remedy.
Never invent a deadline or imply urgency without a verified basis.
Never omit a material limitation that changes what the citizen can rely on.
Never present a citizen assertion as an established record fact.
Never replace official evidence with a convenient secondary source when the official source is required.
